decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric day-patient program draws on core clinical competence, is reimbursed and fills a gap for working patients, so it likely meets aspirations, and the growing firm has slack to let it mature.

Custom-furniture carpentry uses the sheltered workshop's existing production know-how at low incremental cost and gives participants meaningful work, so no shortfall would trigger problemistic search.
Senior-living counseling is prominently featured and feeds clients into the core eldercare business, clearly meeting management's aspirations.
The retail shop's results remain uncertain, but it adds sales and visibility for the workshop, and the firm's expansion provides slack to carry it.
Senior meal delivery is a newly launched extension of the eldercare offer whose results are still uncertain, and slack lets the firm give it time before judging it against aspirations.
